title: What's on your plate
hook: A Viennese breakfast, traced back to its fields.
notes: Shares rounded and approximate: Côte d'Ivoire ≈ 40% of world cocoa; Brazil the largest coffee producer and ≈ 3/4 of orange-juice exports; Ecuador the largest banana exporter (FAO, ICCO, USDA).

scenes.title: Coffee
scenes.text: The Melange starts in Brazil, the world's largest coffee producer, or Vietnam, the second. Coffee itself first grew wild in Ethiopia.

scenes.title: Chocolate and orange juice
scenes.text: Cocoa for the spread comes mostly from Côte d'Ivoire and Ghana. The orange juice almost certainly came from São Paulo state in Brazil.

scenes.title: The banana
scenes.text: Ecuador ships more bananas than any other country, around a quarter of the world's exports.

scenes.title: And from next door
scenes.text: The roll, the butter, the sugar from Lower Austrian beet, and the apricot jam from the Wachau travelled less than 100 km.
